opportunities.name: Expedia rental car search
opportunities.description: Search Expedia for rental cars at a given pick-up location (with drop-off at the same place) for a date range and pick-up/drop-off times, then sort the results.
steps: Open the Cars tab
Type the pick-up location and choose the matching suggestion
Leave drop-off as 'Same as pick-up' or enter the same location
Open the date picker, choose the pick-up and drop-off dates, then click Done
Choose the pick-up and drop-off times
Click Search
Apply filters and sort by Total Price

instances.values: JFK, Apr 3–6 2023, 9:00 am to 6:00 pm, sorted by Total Price
San Francisco, CA, through Apr 8 2023, default times

opportunities.name: Booking.com flight search and select fastest
opportunities.description: Search Booking.com flights from an origin to a destination (one-way or multi-city) on given dates, sort by Fastest, and select a flight through to the next booking step.
steps: Open the Flights tab
Clear the default origin and type the origin city
Type the destination in 'Where to?' and choose the suggestion
Optionally switch to Multi-city and add more legs (from, to, date)
Choose the departure date(s) and set travellers, then click Done
Click Search
Sort by Fastest
Click See flight on the top result, then Select
Choose options and click Next

instances.values: Multi-city: New York → Tokyo (1 Jun 2023), Tokyo → New Delhi (5 Jun 2023)

opportunities.name: MTA planned service changes lookup by route
opportunities.description: Look up MTA planned work or service changes for a given bus/subway route, optionally for a specific date.
steps: Open Planned Work / Planned Service Changes
Type the route in Search Routes and choose it from the list
Optionally open the date picker, move to the right month, and choose the date

opportunities.name: Carnival cruise search
opportunities.description: Search Carnival cruises by destination, departure port, date, and number of guests.
steps: Open 'Sail To' and choose the destination
Optionally open 'Sail From' and choose the departure port
Optionally open Dates and choose a month
Click SEARCH CRUISES
Open Number of Guests and set the guest count

instances.values: Panama Canal from San Francisco, CA, October 2024

opportunities.name: SpotHero airport parking search
opportunities.description: Search SpotHero for airport parking at a given airport for a date range and sort the results.
steps: Open the Airport tab
Type the airport name or code and choose the airport
Choose the parking start and end dates
Sort the results (e.g., by Shuttle Time)
